design.reason: design produces the note and the plan; no code, no commit, before the go-ahead gate.

code.reason: code implements and commits slices locally; shipping is a separate phase.

ship.reason: ship commits, pushes and opens the PR; it doesn't edit source or tests.

release.reason: release bumps, tags and pushes; it doesn't edit source or tests, and `npm version` must carry --no-git-tag-version so it never makes its own commit or tag.

test-writer.reason: the failing-test step writes tests, never implementation.

code-writer.reason: code-writer changes implementation; the slice's tests are frozen, and no src/ write until skill-guard.mjs red has marked a test failing.

reviewer.reason: review applies /code-review + /simplify cleanups; read-only git (the diff) is fine, but it doesn't mutate history, touch tests, or ship.
